reducedMotionJourneys.failures: Blank tab switcher target size 41.796875px vs minimum44px in both browsers; reproduced with original CSS in Chromium.

broaderAppearance.failures: Blank tab height rounding and mobile control size assertions block before reduced-motion selection; representative light cases reproduced with original CSS.

intermediateAccessibilitySplit.failures: Blank exact focus-ring width assertions blocked before typography regression. Original broad appearance checks are retained; focused typography is now independent.
